m: Under the *roof*, *two planks* are nailed down and the builder's *legs* walk off: the house is **finished**.
A *small speech bubble* gives orders while a *war club* knocks in the tent pegs: camp is **set up**.
A *tethered arrow* lies on the *workbench*, cut to the same pattern as all the rest: a standard **form**.
A *python* sheds its skin under a *bent knife*: see how its **colour** shines.
A *kicking foot* and *trudging feet* head for every *mouth* in town: the **road**.
A *small speech bubble* is tied with a *coiled rope* so it won't escape: **recorded**.
A *cross* on top of a warm hut with an open door: the hut faces the **south** sun.
Three *mouths* taste the food, one after another: testing the **product**.
A *standing person* lights a *candle* in the window: someone **lives** here.
A *cow head* pokes over the gate and opens its *mouth* to **tell** you something.
A *big man* sorts *rice* into piles by **kind**.
*Splashing water* everywhere: someone **seeks** a dropped ring in the fountain.
A *helping hand* points at a *lying man* with a *cross* over his *mouth*: **according to** him, he's sick.
*Grain stalk* first, then the *mouth*, then the *king*: food comes in a set **order**.
Two *spoons* back to back, turning away from the cold wind of the **north**.
A *strong arm* pushes the cart to the **side** of the *road*.
A *skeleton* next to a fallen *spoon*: it will never eat again. It **died**.
Draw the *bow* with *long hair* flying: **spread** wide and open.
A *small speech bubble* tells a *person* what they **should** do.
Under the *lid*, through the *curtains*, *scissors* are **handed over**.
A *watcher* makes sure each *person* stays between *two planks*: that's the **rule**.
A *plank* with a hook below it, carrying sack upon sack: **ten thousand** grains.
A *right hand* grabs an *ear* and **takes** it.
A *helping hand* **pulls** the *podium* across the stage.
Under a *tree*, *trudging feet* step from square to square around a *mouth*: a **grid**.
Beside a *tombstone*, under the *moon*, a *king* gazes up and **hopes**.
The *watcher* under a sparkling crown **feels** something is near.
A *drop* of glue on a *tree* branch: the grafting **technique**.
In the *teepee*, an *elbow* tugs at the *page*'s **collar**.
Everyone jumps the same *hurdle* behind the same *curtains*: a **common** race.
A *stone* as hard as an *ox horn*: **solid**, sure.
A *standing person* bends an *elbow* and **passes on** the baton.
The one holding the *banner* in front of the class: the **teacher**.
A *right hand* shades the *watcher*'s eyes as he **watches**.
*Water drops* run over green *moss*: the stream is **clear**.
Inside the *teepee*, a *boomerang* lands right at your feet: it's here **now**.
A *knife* slices clean through the *bent cross* in one stroke: **definitely** done, no doubt.
Below the *hillside*, under a *roof*, *two planks* make a bench where tired *legs* rest: the **courtyard**.
A *small speech bubble* calls from *upstairs*: "**Let** them come up!"
A *small speech bubble* and a *mouth* behind *curtains* whisper what they **know**.
A man stands by the post, leaning on his bow: **waiting**.
A *picket fence* of buckles across the waist: a **belt**.
A *cobra* follows the snake charmer's *thumb*: he **leads** it.
A *bent knife* above two hands grabbing a stick: both **strive** to win.
*Two planks* and an *elbow* push a load along the *road*: **transport**.
*Bamboo* tickles a *dancer* until she **laughs**.
A *swan* spreads its wings: **fly**!
*Scissors* on a *small table* in the yard spin round in a gust: the **wind**.
At the *stop sign*, a *trailing foot* takes one more **step**.
A *cane* beats a *coiled rope* until it straightens: **changed**.
A *cane* hooks the *twisted vine* full of grapes and pulls it in: **received**, harvested.
Under the *tree*, a mole meets the *glare* of the deep **root**.
A *plank* nailed on a *cross*: the main **trunk** of the tree.
On the *road*, a *cow head* and a shouting *mouth* haul stones to **build** a bridge.
A *lid* over lines pouring from a mouth: **words**.
An *ear* listens; *horns* point to the *sky*: all creatures **unite**.
A *helping hand* and a *thumb* grip a fistful of *soil* and **hold** it.
A *silk thread* ties each rung of the *stepladder*: **organized** in order.
A *mother* in a *slanted cap* checks on **every** child.
*Water drops* over a *trimmed hedge*: you **aid** the garden by watering it.
A *bent cross* of an axle and a *cross* of a wheel: a **car** seen from above.
On the *podium*, a *cross* stands among *crumbs* of cake: the **parent** cuts the birthday cake.
The *chaser* climbs the *tree* to the very top: **extremely** high.
A *tree* next to a *tree*: the **woods**.
Under the *moon*, a *kneeling man* lifts **clothes** with his *right hand* and dresses.
A *standing heart* beats fast as a *person* runs: **quick**!
A *strong arm* parts the *curtains* to **handle** the matter.
A *small speech bubble* goes before the *judge*: the case is **discussed**.
*Footsteps* walk **towards** the *candle* in the dark.
*Two planks* on *legs*: a counter where you pay in **yuan**.
A *big man* stands on the *grass* under an *archway* of flowers: the **hero**.
A *cross* above a *plank*: the **scholar** standing straight and wise.
A *small speech bubble* at the *goal line* shouts it went in: here is the **proof**.
An *axe* lies on the *road*, so **near** you nearly trip.
A *person* drops *two planks* that *slide* away: **lost**.
An *elbow* yanks the *cart* round: **turn**!
A *person* with *two planks* across him, like a hairpin and a yoke: a grown **husband**.
Under the *teepee*, the chief raises an *elbow* and gives an **order**.
A *sparrow* lands on the *icicles* without slipping: **accurate**.
A *left hand* **spreads** a *towel* on the table.
A *woman* lifts an *elbow* and opens her *mouth*: the song **begins**.
Your *heart* stands under *two planks* of a bridge: **how** do I cross?
A *mouth* asks a *lying man* holding a *spoon*: "And you?" The **question particle**.
A *left hand* and a *standing person* lead a *child* to the bank to **deposit** savings.
A *tree* with a short *plank* on top: its branches have **not yet** grown.
*Legs* walk along *two planks* down the *road*: so **far**.
A *mouth* tangled in a *twisted vine* **shouts** for help.
An *elbow* leans on a *mouth*-shaped box: a **platform** to stand on.
*Horns* on top of a long scroll: the **list** of cattle to buy.
The *sun* lights *crumbs* and *bristles*, and each throws an **image**, a **shadow**.
An *eye* on legs, a lens on a stand: a **tool**.
A *fishing net* cast at the *dusk moon* comes up full: **collecting** the catch.
A *child* under a *roof* learns to write each **character**.
A *left hand* and a *right hand* hold together: **love**.
A hammer above a *mountain* **strikes** the rock.
*Water drops* carry a *tumbling baby* boat as it **flows** downstream.
*Trudging feet* go out to the *rice field* to **prepare** for planting.
Two hands hold up an axe: a **soldier**.
A *cart* **linked** to another along the *road*.
A *small speech bubble* gives the order: the *mouth* in the *rice field* is **transferred** to the town.
*Water drops* pour through a *torn net* past the roots of a *tree*: the pool is **deep**.
Under an *archway*, behind the *curtains*, a *mouth* haggles: the **merchant**.
*Bamboo* counting sticks laid on the *grass*, an *eye* checking each one: **calculating**.
Under a *leaning cliff*, a *cross* is scratched on a *shell* to test its true **nature**.
A *green shoot* in a *fence*: the gardeners gather **round** it in a ring.
Each *sparrow* flies to the *tree* to **gather**.
A *white dove* under a *plank*: one dove with a **hundred** feathers.
*Rain* drips off an old man's *beard*: he **needs** an umbrella.
A *standing person* points at another *person*'s goods: what's the **price**?
In the *grass*, a *standing person* with a *spoon* waters a **flower**.
*Sprinkles* over the *cloth cover*; every *mouth* cheers and *legs* dance: a **party**.
A *standing person* with a *spoon* and a *cross* of gold: a **splendid** feast.
*Soil* piled high keeps out the *swarm*; a *halberd* guards the gate: the **city** walls.
Under the *awning* of a cliff, a *mouth*-shaped boulder: a **stone**.
A *silk thread* lets the *chaser* climb one **level** at a time.
A *tree*, a *mouth*, a *cane* and a *goal line*: everything is here, the **whole** set.
Under the *shed*, a *standing person* presses a *thumb* seal: the **government** office.
A *paw print* in the snow, heading away: the fox has **left**.
*Icicles*, a frozen *mouth*, shivering *legs*: a bad **situation**.
A *plank* under the *scaffold*: one step below the top, **second**.
A *small speech bubble* over green *moss* lawns: "Please come in," an **invitation**.
A *helping hand* whittles a *branch* into a flute: real **skill**.
An *altar* stands on the *hillside* at the **border**.
A *silk thread* tied round the *ladle*: a reminder of your dinner **appointment**.
*Two planks* of an altar with *crumbs* of offering: a sign to **show** the gods.
A traveller in a *slanted cap* turns round and **returns** home.
A *tripod* of medicine bottles beside the *sickbed*: **illness**.
Air in through the *nose*, down to the *heart*: a **breath**.
A *crowbar* pries open the *cave*: time to **investigate**.
*Twin blades* snip the *silk thread*: a short **thread**.
A *standing person* next to a *person*: they **seem** alike.
Under the *roof*, files in *stacked drawers*: the **official**'s office.
Flames leap up with sparks on each side: **fire**.
An *axe* comes down and the rope **snaps**: **broken**.
*Rice* polished until it gleams like green *moss*: the pure **essence**.
*Water drops* fill the jar to the brim: **full**.
A *right hand* holds up a *cross* of branches: **supporting** it.
A *watcher* at the *small altar* **looks at** the offerings.
*Water drops* and *sprinkles* under the *moon*: the flood slowly **subsides**.
A *runner* jumps the *open crate* and a *halberd*: he **climbs over** all of them.
Four *mouths* bark round a *dog*: a noisy **device** of a guard.
A *roof* over a whole *valley*: room to **contain** everything.
The *sun* shines on a *knife* and a *mouth* above the *embers*: cook **according to** the recipe.
*Bristles* grow on the *page*'s chin: he **must** shave.
A *slash* and a long *swoop*: an arm bent into a **nine**.
The *sun* warms the *soil* and the crops **increase**.
A *stone* rolls back and forth under the *door bar*: **grinding** corn.
Under a *cloth cover*, you **write** a card for a *gift*.
A *grain stalk* is cut with a *bent knife* and the *crumbs* go on the scales: **weigh** it.
A *person* on tiptoe at the *stop sign*, looking ahead: **anticipating** what comes.
